- (c) Now, fixing pay in ex cadre post in Level 11 of Pay Matrix (with DA@ 15%) on the basis of emoluments drawn in parent cadre:  
Pay in ex cadre i.e. { 88,992 shall comprise of { 77,384 (Basic Pay) plus { 11,608 (DA@ 15%).  
Since there is no cell in Level 11 of Pay Matrix matching { 77,384 pay will be fixed at { 78,500, i.e. next cell in higher stage. So, the pay in ex cadre post will be fixed at { 78,500.
